rules.STRONG-COLLAPSE (A): R_SD <= 0.5 AND frozen R1 reversal count <= half the natural R1 count
rules.WEAK-COLLAPSE (B): R_SD >= 0.9 AND frozen R1 count > half the natural R1 count
rules.note: R_SD <= 0.5 is a descriptive screening threshold (as Family A), not a significance test; no additive variance decomposition

R1.definition: historical decision-rule definition: fraction of the 15 Delta with sign opposite to sign(M), M = mean of seed means, computed within each regime
